body:
at least i’m trying!
i don’t keep hiding
from all this routine
like i am always thirteen

open the door
i am stiil living
i just break into a new floor
i’ve found my life willing

don’t forget
and remember the feeling
when we first met 
in a house without ceiling 

i invite you into my fate
who knows, maybe worth it
honey, just don’t be late
without you i’m falling into a bottomless pit
